# Aurora

> Aurora is a free, open-source music player without ads or tracking. Search for any song or artist, build playlists, and start listening. Cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux), privacy-respecting, and AGPL licensed.

## Links

- [Home](https://aurora-player.org): Website
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/danidetenerife/aurora): Source code
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/JqPjKxE): Community chat
- [Documentation](https://docs.aurora-player.org): Docs
